close_reason: Fixed in next commit. CreateError::Server reshaped from holding String to holding JmapError. All three leak sites (process_create lines 813, 845, 943) now build via server_fail_from_backend(&e). Dispatch site rebuilt to format from JmapError.error_type + .description. Site 856 (Envelope deserialize) is out of scope — that's client-input parse text into invalidProperties.description, not a backend leak. cargo test, clippy, fmt all clean.
description:
src/submission.rs process_create lines 796 and 828: 
  .map_err(|e| CreateError::Server(e.to_string()))

This builds a CreateError::Server(String) which at lines 429-430 is rendered as { type: serverFail, description: msg }. The msg interpolates backend e.to_string(), same wire-leak hazard the c64d655 sweep fixed elsewhere.

Three more sites in the same file have the same shape: line 796 (identity get_objects failure), line 828 (email get_objects failure), line 926 (BackendSetError::Other variant in CreateError mapping).

Fix: rewire CreateError::Server to carry a typed error or a stable string that is NOT the backend's Display impl, OR remove CreateError::Server and have the variants map directly via server_fail_from_backend before the create returns. Either way, the goal is no backend Display text on the wire.
title: process_create error mapping leaks backend Display text
